pages.text: $(li)Ensorcellators are slow, so build more than one fracturer for egg processing (at least 2–3; some players go one per egg).

$(li)The Rainbow input hatch is bound to the player who placed it, not chunk-based—moving it won’t rebind it to another player.$(li)Blood tanks are needed for the Skythern Core, and full blood tanks for Sacrifice Metal Armor (which needs aragonite levels of orichalcos).
$(li)A fully built corium reactor (e.g., ~1,000 casings + controller + cells on standby) is safe to operate near your base, with no dangerous side effects.
